description: Search the virtual XML templates that ship with the game — the frames an addon can inherit by name to get Blizzard's own look and behaviour (buttons, scroll lists, panels, tooltips). Shows the inheritance chain, attached mixins and where each is defined. Use this instead of writing frame art from scratch.

query.description: Template name or fragment, e.g. ScrollBox or UIPanelButton.

type.description: Restrict to an element type, e.g. Button, Frame, CheckButton.

name: wow_ui_template_search
title: Search Blizzard's XML frame templates
